text:
sam: Heads-up: targeting quiet window tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC to roll kernel+quant v3.0 (quantize3). This is the rollout that enables int8 matmul path and new permutation kernels.
ei: Ack. What is the staged plan? full rolling or tenant-sliced?
sam: Tenant-sliced. Start with infra-only (control plane), then low-traffic tenants (5 tenants, ~0.5% total), then tenant groups by SLA: best-effort -> standard -> dedicated.
rachel: Important: quant v3.0 has a change in softmax scaling that can shift logits by tiny amounts. For reranking workflows that expect exact token sequences (search highlights) we need golden-eval checks.
troy: Also check embeddings stability. We saw a drift in last quant roll where cosine similarity dropped ~0.02 for some models. Need threshold gating.
sam: Rollout commands: `/deploybot rollout kernel quantize3 --strategy tenant-slice --slices 5 --quiet-window 02:00-03:30`
ei: Gate metrics: 1) rerank CI fail rate >0.2% over baseline triggers hold, 2) embeddings cosine median <0.98 with baseline triggers investigate, 3) request-error >0.3% for 3m triggers rollback.
rachel: For tenants with dedicated SLA, we can apply a per-tenant pin: `/deploybot pin kernel quantize3 --tenant <tenant-id> --reason "SLA pin"`
troy: Who's watching telem? I'll take 02:00-02:45, Sam covers 02:45-03:30.
ei: Preflight steps: 1) build artifact + artifact-hash check, 2) run `golden-eval --suite rerank --variants 12`, 3) run `embed-check --model all --sample 500`. If any check fails, abort.
sam: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/quantize3-rollout. Infra-bot will post perf snapshots.
deploybot: rollout scheduled by sam for 1733334444. Quiet window reserved.
infra-bot: preflight started at 1733334500. Artifact hash OK. Golden-eval queued.
ei: Golden-eval result: 11/12 pass; failing case is a long-rerank with a softmax edge-case. Attaching diffs: small token reorder in 2 prompts.
rachel: That's the exact class we feared. Is it reproducible locally?
troy: Running localized replay against tenant-01 dataset now.
ei: Replay shows rerank score flip for 0.3% queries. Embeddings median cosine = 0.986 (baseline 0.992) on sampled set. Not great.
sam: Given SLA tenant groups and the rerank risk, proposal: proceed with infra-only and low-traffic tenant slices but block standard & dedicated until we push a mitigation that clamps softmax offsets. Also post a public-facing note to affected customers.
rachel: Mitigation idea: introduce a post-quant smoother that rescales logits to match float baseline distribution. Could be a transtional shim.
troy: That might cost some cycles. We need to measure perf impact; but better than rollback. Can we run shim on canary tenants only?
ei: Yes, we can feature-flag the smoother per-tenant. Implement as `--logit-normalize` flag in runtime. For canary tenants enable it.
sam: OK plan updated: 02:00 infra-only smoke; 02:15 low-traffic tenants slice 1 (with smoother enabled); 02:40 analyze rerank+embed metrics; 03:00 decide on standard/dedicated.
deploybot: starting infra-only deploy for quantize3 at 1733334560.
troy: infra-only smoke PASS. No errors. Perf within expected bounds.
ei: Deploying slice 1 (low-traffic tenants) with smoother flag: `/deploybot swap start --version quantize3 --tenants slice-low --flags logit-normalize`
deploybot: slice 1 started for quantize3 on tenants slice-low. Monitoring enabled.
rachel: Early metrics: rerank fail rate 0.05% above baseline but within threshold. Embeds median cosine 0.990 — improved with smoother.
troy: At 02:30 I see one tenant in slice-low with some downstream search highlight diffs; customer reported NoMajorImpact but flagged.
ei: Noted. We'll add that tenant to exclusion list for standard rollout. `/deploybot pin kernel quantize3 --tenant tenant-03 --ttl 72h --note "exclude from std rollout due to highlight diffs"`
deploybot: pin applied for tenant-03.
sam: Proceeding to analyze telemetry for 20m before next slice.
infra-bot: telemetry window ended: rerank drift stable at +0.03% across slice-low; embedding median cosine 0.989.
rachel: Given smaller-than-feared drift and smoothing helping, I'm okay to move to standard tenants, but we must keep dedicated pinned until we have a float-compat shim or updated quant kernel.
troy: I'd prefer a staged standard rollout with per-tenant opt-out. Also, before touching dedicated we need the perf cost of smoother validated. Run `perf-local --with-shim` on representative hosts.
ei: Perf-local shows ~4% CPU increase and ~1.5% median latency bump with smoother on. Acceptable for standard but maybe not for certain dedicated GPU-bound tenants.
sam: Decision: standard rollout proceeds at 03:05. Dedicated remains pinned. We'll create a customer advisory and open INF-5012 to track dedicated tactics.
rachel: I'll draft the release note: summary, known small rerank drift for some edge-case prompts, mitigation (logit-normalize), pinned dedicated tenants, contact channel.
troy: I'll run perf sweep on dedicated-1 hosts to simulate impact; if acceptable we can unpin later.
ei: CI will run final golden-eval against entire standard tenant set at 03:10; if any new failure >0.1% abort and pin standard.
deploybot: starting standard_1 slice at 1733334900.
infrastructure note: at 1733334699 infra-bot posts: monitoring flagged one new anomaly: tenant-08 had an embed cosine drop to 0.975 briefly; we auto-pinned tenant-08 as precaution.
sam: Good catch. Auto-pin accepted. `/deploybot pin kernel quantize3 --tenant tenant-08 --ttl 24h --note "auto-pin embed drift"`
deploybot: pin applied for tenant-08.
rachel: Actions: 1) keep dedicated pinned, 2) add smoother as opt-in flag for dedicated tenants, 3) owners ei + troy to iterate on shim perf, 4) ops to send advisory to tenants impacted, 5) create issue INF-5012 for dedicated unpin criteria.
sam: Thanks team. Will close this thread after release notes posted and issues created. If new regressions show up, reopen. :eyes:"
